description: Ireland: is the rent from a room in your own home tax-free under Rent-a-Room relief?

exclusion.description: Who rents the room (default none = a lodger or student staying more than 28 days)

expenses.description: Your share of expenses a year, EUR (only count when taxed)

extrasMonthly.description: Meals, laundry, cleaning charged a month, EUR (default 0)

furnishings.description: Furniture for the room bought in the last 8 years, EUR

owners.description: People entitled to the rent, joint owners (default 1)

pay.description: Your gross salary a year, EUR (default 50,000)

rentMonthly.description: Rent a month for the room(s), EUR

status.description: Tax status, used if the income is taxed (default single)

name: ireland_rent_a_room_relief
